# v0.4.6 — Every topic is a cell under main chat

## What's changed

- **The topic cluster.** Under TheOne's main-chat card, every topic is now a round cell drawn like TheOne's mark, and the cells cling together like a raft of soap bubbles. Recently used topics are bigger and sit higher; topics that share a topic workspace or that TheOne learned are related stick together. Each cell carries a short name, written by the same routing call that created the topic. Busy cells show their names; move the pointer over the cluster and the cell under it swells and shows its name, one at a time. Past about a dozen topics the least used fold into a "+N" cell. The cluster replaces the Topic workspaces row in the sidebar; with no topics yet, the row stays. With the sidebar collapsed, only the active topics remain as small cells.
- **See where each message goes.** When you send a message, a small vesicle leaves the main-chat mark and flies into the topic it went to, which lights up and starts answering. A new topic buds off the mark. A topic that is answering glows and breathes; one that has answered and waits its turn for main chat turns white; one waiting for your answer or approval shows a hollow nucleus; one that did not finish shows a dashed rim. The topic main chat is in rises closest to the card.
- **Topic details in one click.** Click a cell, or use the keyboard, to open a small panel beside it: the full name, what it is doing right now (answering, queued and why, waiting for you, did not finish…), and "carry on in main chat". An all-topics list with a filter is always one click away.
- **When TheOne was unsure.** If routing hesitated between topics, the other candidates stay lit until your next message; open one and move the message there, and main chat continues in it.
- **Possible duplicates, side by side.** Two topics that look like the same thing get a quiet dotted thread between their cells. Open it to keep one, say they are different, or decide later. While TheOne is idle, one small model call checks each candidate pair first, so fewer false alarms reach you.
- **Drag and throw.** Drag a cell onto the main-chat card to continue that topic in main chat, or rest it on another cell to merge the two (merges can be undone; while either is still answering, they stay joined and merge once TheOne is idle). Drop it on a chat in the sidebar to attach that chat to the topic. Throw a cell out of the sidebar to set it aside; the next message about it brings it back. Right-click a cell for its menu, including stopping a run or withdrawing a queued message. Keyboard and screen-reader users get the same topics as a list.
- **Main chat holds only the conversation.** With topic notices hidden (the default), TheOne no longer writes routing receipts into main chat; the cluster shows them. Turn topic notices on in TheOne's settings to get the lines back.
- **Deeper routing.** Replies to a question, pending answers and messages sent while a topic is still working go to the right topic without a classification call; bare continuations such as "go on" follow TheOne's own state. A failed routing call is retried once, a quick one-off question is answered without leaving the topic you are in, and a new topic named exactly like an existing one becomes that topic. A topic's Worker gets its briefing only when the briefing changed, and learning from a route is taken back when you correct it. In our paired real-chat runs on this version, routing cost was 1–8% lower and misroutes did less harm in all four groups.
- **Safer when things go wrong.**
  - When you move a message to another topic mid-run, the first topic stops before its next model request instead of carrying on beside the new one.
  - If the routing call times out or fails and the rules cannot tell where a message belongs, TheOne asks you before the first change. No answer means no change.
  - When the model provider rejects a request, main chat shows its actual message, status code and request id instead of a generic "Worker turn did not complete". If changes had already been made, it says so, so you can check before continuing.
  - Stopping one topic no longer clears other queued messages.
- **Fixes.**
  - Re-organising old chats no longer files the same conversation as a new topic each time. Duplicates left by earlier versions are merged once, and the merge can be undone.
  - English names are never split inside a word: a name that does not fit a small cell shows on hover and in its details instead, and punctuation stays with its word.
  - The dotted pore between two possible duplicates now shows where the two cells touch, in the open notch beside them, and holds still while you point at it.
  - The cluster stays light with many topics and DSH windows: in a 300-topic, 30-window benchmark on this version, publishing 50 changes took 49 ms instead of 46 s.
  - TheOne's databases open in WAL mode, cutting local time per message from 207 ms to 16 ms (median, fake-model replay, this version). DSH's default model is switched back when TheOne is removed or turned off, and Settings opens again after a hot update.

After updating: the Topic workspaces row gives way to the topic cluster as soon as you have topics; the full workspace is one click away on the "+N" cell or a cell's menu. If you had turned topic notices on, main chat keeps showing them.

Validation: type checks and the full automated suite (809 tests, including the cluster's state and event mapping, labels that never cut a name, merge queuing and undo, stopping work, handoffs, routing fallbacks, error details, the duplicate-topic repair, whole-word names and the pore placement) pass, and the plugin archive builds. The cluster was run end to end in an isolated DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 web profile, and this version runs in the DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 desktop app.

## 中文

- **话题细胞团**：TheOne 主聊天卡片下面，每个话题都是一颗和 TheOne 标识同样画法的圆细胞，像一团肥皂泡一样挤在一起。最近用过的话题更大、更靠上；同一个话题工作区的话题、TheOne 学到有关联的话题会贴在一起。每颗细胞都有一个短名字，由开出这个话题的那次路由顺手起好。正在做事的细胞会写上名字；鼠标移到细胞团上，指着的那颗会微微胀大并显示名字，一次只显示一个。话题超过十几个时，最少用的会折进一个「+N」细胞。细胞团取代了侧边栏里的「话题工作区」一行；还没有话题时，那一行仍然保留。侧边栏收起时，只留下活跃话题的小细胞。
- **说一句话，看它去了哪**：发出消息时，会有一个小囊泡从主聊天标识飞进它被分到的话题，那个话题随即亮起来开始回答。新话题会从标识里分裂出来。正在回答的话题会发光、呼吸；已经答好、等主聊天展示的变成白色；在等你回答或审批的，细胞核是空心的；没有完成的，边缘是虚线。主聊天当前所在的话题会浮到离卡片最近的位置。
- **点一下看话题详情**：点细胞（或用键盘）会在旁边打开一个小面板：完整的名字、它现在在做什么（正在回答、排队中以及为什么排队、在等你、这次没完成……），以及「在主聊天接着聊」。「所有话题」列表带筛选，随时一键打开。
- **拿不准时**：路由在几个话题之间犹豫时，其他候选话题会一直亮到你发下一条消息；点开其中一个就能把消息换过去，主聊天也接着在那里聊。
- **可能重复的话题**：两个话题看起来是同一件事时，它们的细胞之间会出现一条安静的虚线。点开可以选留哪一个、说「不是一回事」，或者稍后再说。TheOne 空闲时会先用一次小模型调用核对每一对候选，少打扰你。
- **拖动和甩走**：把细胞拖到主聊天卡片上，主聊天就接着聊这个话题；在另一颗细胞上停一下就合并两个话题（合并可以撤销；如果其中一个还在回答，它们会先连在一起，等 TheOne 空下来再合并）；拖到侧边栏里的会话上，就把那个会话关联进这个话题。把细胞甩出侧边栏就是先放一边，下次再聊到它会自己回来。右键细胞有菜单，可以停止运行或撤回排队的消息。键盘和读屏用户可以用一组列表访问同样的话题。
- **主聊天里只有对话**：在默认的「话题提示」隐藏模式下，TheOne 不再往主聊天里写路由回执，这些都由细胞团来表现。想要这些提示，在 TheOne 设置里打开「话题提示」即可。
- **路由更深一层**：回复提问、待回答的问题，以及话题还在工作时追加的消息，不用再调用分类就能去对的话题；「继续」这类简短接续会按 TheOne 自己的状态处理。路由调用失败会重试一次；一次性的小问题会直接回答，不离开当前话题；新话题和已有话题同名时，会直接归到已有话题。话题的 Worker 只在简报变化时才重新收到简报；你纠正路由后，从那次路由学到的东西会被撤回。在这个版本的真实聊天配对测试中，四组里路由成本降低了 1–8%，误路由造成的影响都变小了。
- **出问题时更稳**：
  - 一条消息在执行中被换到别的话题后，原话题会在下一次请求模型之前停下，不会和新话题同时干活。
  - 路由调用超时或失败、规则也判断不了归属时，TheOne 会在第一次改动前先问你；你没回答就不改。
  - 模型服务商拒绝请求时，主聊天会显示它给的具体原因、状态码和请求 ID，不再只有一句「Worker turn did not complete」；如果出错前已经做过改动，会提醒你先检查现状再继续。
  - 停止一个话题，不会再清掉其他排队的消息。
- **修复**：
  - 整理旧会话时，不会再把同一段对话每次都建成一个新话题；旧版本留下的重复话题会合并一次，合并可以撤销。
  - 英文名不会再从单词中间拆成两行：小细胞放不下时，名字在悬停和详情里看；标点跟着前后的字走。
  - 两个可能重复的话题挨在一起时，它们之间的虚线小孔会出现在旁边空着的凹口里，鼠标指着时不会跳。
  - 话题多、DSH 窗口多时，细胞团依然轻快：在这个版本的 300 个话题 × 30 个窗口基准中，连续 50 次改动的发布耗时从 46 秒降到 49 毫秒。
  - TheOne 的数据库改用 WAL 模式，每条消息的本地处理时间从 207 毫秒降到 16 毫秒（中位数，模拟模型回放，本版本）。移除或关闭 TheOne 时会把 DSH 的默认模型换回来；热更新后「设置」可以正常打开。

更新后：只要你有话题，「话题工作区」那一行就会换成话题细胞团；完整的话题工作区可以从「+N」细胞或细胞的菜单一键打开。如果你之前打开了「话题提示」，主聊天会继续显示它们。

验证：类型检查和全部自动化测试（809 项，含细胞团的状态与事件映射、名字绝不截断、合并排队与撤销、停止任务、话题移交、路由降级、错误详情、重复话题修复、英文名不拆词和小孔位置）通过，插件包构建正常；细胞团在隔离的 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 网页 profile 中端到端运行过，这个版本也在 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 桌面版上运行。
